reuse.why: Puts the new check in accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank, and every provider's link handler calls it.

duplication.why: The same await-check-then-delegate wrapper is written out five times at registration, each repeating a provider string that the handler also hardcodes, instead of one higher-order wrapper or a call inside the handlers.

placement.why: The query lives in the link module, but the business precondition is added as inline lambdas in the app.method registration block rather than in the link handlers themselves.

scope.why: Only the check, its wiring and its tests.

maintainability.why: A new provider registered the usual way would silently skip the check, the provider is typed as a plain string rather than AccountSyncSource, and the registration list is now harder to scan.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts ensureAccountNotLinked, called from all five link registrations in accounts/app.ts
